typography.instructions: Use IBM Plex Sans for all headings to give a 'technical/data' feel. Use Inter for body text for maximum legibility. Use JetBrains Mono for coordinates or technical data points.

colors.strategy: Stark white background with deep black text. Use the Primary Blue (#2563EB) ONLY for the main 'Search' action and active states. Avoid gradients. Use 1px borders to define structure.

layout.grid_system: Bento Grid Protocol - Mode B (High Density)
layout.surface_strategy: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Expose the skeleton. Use border-r and border-b for grid items to create a spreadsheet-like but modern feel.

search_section.style: Heroic, centered input field. Minimalist but large.
elements: Search Button (Pill shaped or Sharp Rectangular)

location_card.style: Flat, bordered, no shadow by default. Hover: Lift + Shadow-lg.
structure: Data Points: Grid layout for Address, Website, Socials

export_button.style: Floating Action Button style or Ghost button in header

images.instructions: Use these images as category headers or fallbacks if the API does not return an image. Ensure object-cover is used.

motion.entrance: Staggered fade-in for list items (0.05s delay per item).
motion.hover: Scale 1.02 on cards. Button press scale 0.95.

universal_guidelines: Do not use generic centered layouts for the results grid.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
Prioritize Shadcn components but customize them to match the 'Swiss' aesthetic (sharp corners, high contrast borders).
instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the dashboard with a focus on data clarity. The user wants to 'scrape' and 'collect', so the UI should feel efficient. Use the 'Grid Borders' surface strategy to give it a structured, tool-like appearance. Ensure the Export to CSV button is easily accessible.
